gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i1: Verifies that two entries with the same flags byte are NOT equal when one has an actual access timestamp stored and the other only has the access-time flag bit
ADDED i2: entryWithFlagOnly: ACCESS_TIME_BIT (bit 1) is set via setFlags, but no access time value is stored.
ADDED i3: entryWithAccessTime: access time is set via FileTime (4 ms since epoch). setAccessFileTime() internally sets ACCESS_TIME_BIT in the flags as well.
ADDED i4: Even though both entries end up with the same flags byte (ACCESS_TIME_BIT = 2), they differ in their stored access-time value, so equals() must return false.
